Newegg Commerce, Inc. is a publicly traded company on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol **NEGG**. It is majority-owned by the Chinese technology firm **Hangzhou Liaison Interactive Information Technology Co.** (and its subsidiary Digital Grid), which holds over 53% of the company's shares. [](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Newegg)

- **Hangzhou Liaison Interactive / Digital Grid:** Owns roughly 53.12% of the company, giving them controlling interest. Company board member Zhitao He controls this parent stake.

- **Fred Chang (Faching Chang):** The original founder who started Newegg in 2001 retains a significant individual share (around 19%).

- **Other Investors:** Various individual insiders and private entities (such as Vladimir Galkin) hold the remaining minority shares
